perspective:
From Ethan’s perspective, he has access to the following information:

- Ethan knows he is a plumber and Gary is his long-time friend since middle school; Gary works as a doctor at a hospital.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep.
- Ethan became concerned and invited Gary to a two-day weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation.
- Gary told Ethan he appreciated the concern but said he couldn’t go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work.
- Ethan suspected there was more behind Gary’s overworking than just professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, telling him they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- Gary told Ethan, “It’s complicated... I didn’t want to burden you with my problems.”
- After that, Gary opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities, telling Gary he didn’t have to do everything himself.
- Gary agreed and said he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary, discussed his progress and remaining challenges, and saw Gary making efforts to change.
- Ethan felt hopeful and proud and continued offering support and encouragement.
- Gary told Ethan things were better, thanked him for his help, said he was not as overwhelmed, and mentioned having time for a movie the previous weekend.
- After a year, Ethan observed that Gary seemed capable of managing on his own with a healthier work-life balance.
- Ethan felt satisfied and happy for Gary, decided to step back, and told Gary he was always just a call away, that he knew Gary had this, and to keep up the great work.
- Gary thanked Ethan, said he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and said he felt more in control now.
